news_items.headline: TSMC Q1 profit rises 58%, beats estimates as AI demand fuels record run
news_items.summary: TSMC reported Q1 profit up 58% YoY, beating street estimates; revenue NT$1.134 trillion vs NT$1.127 trillion expected. HPC (AI/5G) rose to 61% of revenue; advanced nodes (<=7nm) comprised 74% of wafer revenue.

news_items.headline: TSMC and ASML post-earnings stock moves signal AI chip demand still hot
news_items.summary: Post-earnings coverage noted TSMC's strong beat as a signal of sustained AI infrastructure demand; company guided full-year 2026 revenue growth >30% YoY in USD terms.

news_items.headline: Prediction: TSMC Stock Will Jump 3x by 2030
news_items.summary: Motley Fool analysis published today argues TSMC's monopoly on advanced node manufacturing and AI-driven demand sets up multi-year compounding growth; no near-term catalyst cited beyond ongoing AI capex.

news_items.headline: Bernstein: AI Agents drive chip demand 'off the charts,' supply can't keep up — TSMC key beneficiary
news_items.summary: Bernstein analyst flagged AI Agent proliferation as driving semiconductor demand beyond forecasts while highlighting TSMC as the most exposed foundry to any demand slowdown or acceleration.

news_items.headline: TSMC Arizona Fab 4 fully committed through late 2027 before construction starts; pricing 25-30% above Taiwan
news_items.summary: Reports indicate TSMC's fourth planned Arizona facility is already fully booked before breaking ground, with customers accepting production quotes 25-30% above equivalent Taiwan pricing.

news_items.headline: TSMC plans major chip packaging plant in Arizona via Amkor partnership
news_items.summary: TSMC announced a partnership with Amkor to open an advanced chip packaging facility in Arizona, expanding its U.S. manufacturing footprint beyond wafer fabrication.

news_items.headline: MediaTek appoints former TSMC executive Douglas Yu as part-time adviser for AI chip and advanced packaging push
news_items.summary: MediaTek hired ex-TSMC executive Douglas Yu as a part-time adviser as it ramps advanced packaging capabilities and competes in the AI chip market; signals TSMC's talent and IP remain industry reference points.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Consensus of 7 analysts at Strong Buy with avg PT $387.14 (range $210–$480); Motley Fool published bullish 3x-by-2030 thesis on 2026-05-05. No specific downgrades or PT cuts found in last 7 days; Bernstein highlighted demand risk to the upside.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 earnings reported 2026-04-16: profit +58% YoY, revenue beat. Company guided full-year 2026 revenue growth >30% in USD. Next earnings expected mid-July 2026; no earnings blackout risk for the near-term setup.
